Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 4
Reason for Mistake: The Planner mis-synthesized the retrieved genres and incorrectly concluded that both bands share the post-punk genre. INXS’s listed genres (new wave, pub rock, dance-rock, funk rock, alternative rock) do not include post-punk, whereas Tappi Tíkarrass does. The correct shared umbrella genre is rock. This was a prioritization error of a non-overlapping subgenre and a premature finalization with an incorrect answer.
